name: A fisherman’s letter

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Jorgen passes a sealed letter to Elling Trias.
description: Jorgen recognizes the bishop’s seal and accepts the duty reluctantly. He writes another letter for Elling Trias and insists that the confidence placed in him pass onward intact. No weapon is drawn, yet the chain of trust is already a route: from a church office, through a fisherman, toward a man who trades in information. The search moves by people who know how to keep a name quiet.
